business_summary: Beijing Kingee Culture Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, research and development, and sale of gold and jewelry under the Jinyi, Yuewang Jewelry, and Yue Wang Ancient Gold brands in China. It offers gold jewelry, precious metal investment products, and diamond and jade jewelry through retail and directly operated brand stores, as well as online markets; digital transformation technology and product, such as software development and technical services, operation and maintenance, and consulting services to banks and other financial institutions in areas, including wealth management and financial markets, payment and settlement, and intelligent digital customer service. The company also provides wealth management and financial market business solutions, payment and settlement business solutions, and related intelligent digital customer service solutions; and gold and silver products, jewelry, watches, stamps, coins, souvenirs, paper products, handicrafts, cultural supplies, rubber products, clothing, shoes and hats, textiles, daily necessities, ceramic products, leather products, plastic products, toys, electronic products, bags, audio equipment, cosmetics, collectibles, and cultural relics. In addition, it is involved in organizing cultural and artistic exchange activities; animation and derivative product design services; artistic performances; undertaking exhibitions and displays. The company was formerly known as Beijing Kingee Culture Development Ltd. and changed its name to Beijing Kingee Culture Development Co., Ltd. in July 2010. Beijing Kingee Culture Development Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Beijing, China.
